comment: The mode switch only matters while the excitation jack is patched: with nothing there the module runs its own oscillator at the V/OCT pitch and is a voice in its own right. In audio mode the input is filtered by a parallel bandpass bank at the five formant frequencies rather than exciting the bursts, so a drum or an oscillator takes on the vowel colour.
